changelog: Notes+ 16.5: formatting stays exactly where you put it (bold, strike, code and colours no longer spill onto the next line), and the format bar shows in full. Includes 16.4's edit-as-it-looks text notes. Install over this version; don't uninstall first.

desktop.changelog: Notes+ 16.4 for Windows: notes edited as they look, like WordPad, with a format bar; italics fixed; stored as Markdown shared with your phone and the web.
